description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for the Git version control system, specifically testing 'git fetch' behavior with negative refspecs and related scenarios. It includes setup commands, repository cloning, configuration, and various fetch command tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands specified in setup, and checks for success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file or command output for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and expects them to be identical.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test finishes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes.
